name: Browsertrix Crawler v1.15.0
body:
## What's Changed
* quickfix: log interrupt reason by @ikreymer in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1155
* crawler: add addLinkBatch function by @mistydemeo in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1137
* Bump to Brave 1.93 by @ikreymer in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1151
* deps: browsertrix-behaviors 0.13.1 by @mistydemeo in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1158
* argParser: remove startEarly by @mistydemeo in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1154
* Show the current page URL as a clickable link in the screencast view by @aponb in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1153
* optimization: drop low priority duplicate request fetch by @ikreymer in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1157
* docs: correct signature for awaitPageLoad by @mistydemeo in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1159
* skippedPages: write text format + enable reportSkipped by default by @mistydemeo in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1162
* Register execution contexts via injected behaviors. by @ikreymer in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1165
* quickfix: remove deprecated url.parse() by @ikreymer in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1163
* browser: add configurable --browserStartTimeout by @aponb in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1160
* ci: switch release action by @mistydemeo in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1166
* Added extended auto-QA features by @lasztoth in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/998
* deps: browsertrix-behaviors 0.15.0 by @mistydemeo in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1169
* Add try/catch to request fail/continue calls by @ikreymer in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1171
* deps: bump brave to 1.96.60 by @ikreymer in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1172
* QA Random Sampling + Docs Update by @ikreymer in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1170
* make sha1 digests make working again for response records by @aponb in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1173
* test fix: pageinfo_test static assets by @ikreymer in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/1174

## New Contributors
* @lasztoth made their first contribution in https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/pull/998

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/webrecorder/browsertrix-crawler/compare/v1.14.3...v1.15.0
